'''Renee Brand''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Chewbacca Con Death Star II Closed Environment (29 July)]] on 29 July 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops]], according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2758">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-father-william-and-endor-closed-7-29-01d2758/ father-william-and-endor-closed-7-29-01], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 1 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-father-william-and-endor-closed-7-29-01d2758/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
